Official teaching note states she very rarely accepts PhD students who have not first completed the ACS, asks applicants not to email CV attachments, and says summer internships are sometimes possible for Cambridge University students but not more widely.

Official themes: Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence; Natural Language Processing; Security.
